shortDescription: Lennox said it expects full-year adjusted earnings per share of $21-$21.50. The headline "Lennox Sees FY EPS $21.00-EPS $21.50 >LII," published at 6:45 a.m. ET on Oct. 28, incorrectly said the guidance was for GAAP EPS.
